title: PyExtal: A Python Package for Electron Structure and Structure Factor Refinement using Quantitative Convergent-Beam Electron Diffraction Intensities
content: We introduce PyExtal, a new Python package designed for refining structure and structure factors from quantitative electron diffraction datasets. This refinement process fits experimental rocking curves to simulated ones computed using the Bloch-wave theory. Traditionally, rocking curve profiles are acquired via energy-filtered convergent beam electron diffraction (CBED). An alternative approach is to use double rocking beam electron diffraction (RBED) proposed by Eades [1]. Recently, with the advancement of pixelated detectors, this method has drawn renewed attention in the electron microscopy community with modern interpretations of the rocking method by Koch et al. [2]. and Beanland et al. [3] and recently implemented as a high-throughput technique [4]. The goal of PyExtal is to provide a comprehensive solution for the refinement of both CBED and RBED datasets.
